name: 生死簿上无她名
overview: On the eve of her wedding, heiress Nan Xingwan suffers a car accident that separates her soul from her body. To survive, she must collect three “true tears” within thirty days. Guided by the enigmatic ferryman Shen Du, she uncovers hidden conspiracies, while he faces memories of a forgotten past. Together, they challenge fate to reclaim life and love.
